share.heading: Share
share.description: Anyone with these links can see your vehicles and sets, without signing in. They can't see purchase prices, notes or tags, and can't change anything.

share.regenerated: New share links created. The old ones no longer work.
share.regenerateError: Couldn't create new share links. Please try again.
share.regenerateConfirmDescription: The current links stop working straight away. Anyone you shared them with will need the new ones.

share.disabled: Sharing is off. The links no longer work.
share.disableError: Couldn't turn sharing off. Please try again.
share.disableConfirmDescription: The links stop working straight away. Turning sharing back on later makes new links; these ones never work again.

dangerZone.heading: Danger Zone
dangerZone.lead: Clear one kind of data, tidy up what nothing uses, or start over. Your account, settings, share link and saved backups are never touched.
dangerZone.snapshotNote: A safety snapshot of everything as it is now is saved on the server first, so this can be undone by restoring it.
dangerZone.resetDoneToast: {{action}}: done. A safety snapshot was saved on the server first.

clearNotes.name: Clear notes
clearNotes.removes: Removes the notes on every vehicle and set.

clearTags.name: Clear tags
clearTags.removes: Removes every tag, from all your vehicles and sets.

clearPurchasePrices.name: Clear purchase prices
clearPurchasePrices.removes: Removes the purchase price from every vehicle and set, so the collection value starts over.

removeUnusedLookups.name: Remove unused lookups
removeUnusedLookups.removes: Removes the manufacturers, series, vehicle types and colors no vehicle or set uses.

removeUnusedPhotos.name: Remove unused photo files
removeUnusedPhotos.removes: Deletes uploaded photo files no vehicle or set uses any more (left behind by deletes, resets and restores), to free disk space.
removeUnusedPhotos.keeps: Keeps every photo in use, and anything uploaded in the last hour.

resetVehicles.name: Reset vehicles
resetVehicles.removes: Removes every vehicle, with its photos, tags and set links.
resetVehicles.keeps: Keeps your sets, lookups, tags, account and settings. Photo files stay until you remove unused ones.

resetSets.name: Reset sets
resetSets.removes: Removes every set, with its photos, tags and vehicle links.
resetSets.keeps: Keeps your vehicles, lookups, tags, account and settings. Photo files stay until you remove unused ones.

resetEverything.name: Reset everything
resetEverything.removes: Removes every vehicle and set, all tags, and every manufacturer, series, vehicle type and color.
resetEverything.keeps: Keeps your account, settings, share link and saved backups. Photo files stay until you remove unused ones.
